calculation_notes: Use posted service rows from the Service Log for July-December 2026. Baseline is 2026-07 through 2026-09; review is 2026-10 through 2026-12. Join Route Lookup by route_id. Reliability gap is scheduled_trips minus on_time_trips. Gap rate is gap divided by scheduled_trips. Crowding pressure is review crowding_reports per 10,000 typical monthly boardings. Index review gap rate, gap-rate worsening, crowding pressure, and rider_sensitivity_index across current routes, then blend 40/25/20/15. Top attention route is Hill Connector at 84.0. Lowest attention route is Harbor Shuttle at 3.9. Fastest worsening is Hill Connector at 7.0 pp. Largest reliability gap is Airport Rapid at 780. Crowding pressure hotspot is Campus Loop at 46.4 per 10,000. District gap leader is Core at 1080. Top attention band count is 3.
